class.description: SplineTweenerControl (`godot::VBoxContainer`, Tier 3 UI Tool) Interactive Multi-Track Spline Tween & BlendShape Editor mounting a master `[0.0 .. 1.0]` scrubber, track generator buttons, and a stack of per-track `Spline1DControl` editors. Part of IdeamSplines (2D/3D Bezier/Catmull-Rom splines and scene-space spline editing).
